enabled.title: Use the profile account
enabled.description: Turns the extension on or off for every profile. Users can't change it when set.

excludedSites.title: Excluded sites
excludedSites.description: Up to 100 host names (subdomains included) whose sign-ins are left alone. Replaces the user's list.

allowPause.title: Allow users to pause
allowPause.description: Shows the Pause button that lets a user sign in with a different account for 15 minutes. Default: true.

allowedDomains.title: Only for these account domains
allowedDomains.description: Trusted work domains (subdomains included), for example contoso.com. Skips account-type discovery. Empty or unset = check whether the domain is work or school.
